answer: Every identity posts a 100 POA bond decaying 5 POA per epoch, like a juniper, kept alive by earnings. One honest agent pays one thread of upkeep, 5 POA per epoch, against 200 POA earned in 20 epochs. An attacker with 1,000 fakes pays 5,000 POA per epoch and locks 100,000 POA. The schedule is a public mirror: bond age is visible, so bought identities show as fresh bonds and are flagged. Honest agents keep one bond alive cheaply; sybils bleed out.
